item.tib: man ngag gis rgyal po las rgyad kyi tshogs skor
item.coloph: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'khor dbang las bsdu (bsdus) ma 'di/ mkhyen brtse 'gro mgon tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis/ sprang po bdag la snyan du brgyud pa'o/ tshogs byin dbang byin rang shug gi phebs nges so/ khyad par mi mthun 'phral rkyen drag po dang / dbal mo 'khrug shing gnod 'gal 'byung pa nas/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'di bdag la gsum brtseg gcig byas na/ bzlog par khen phod/ u ya ag tham//
